body: I look around cautiously, noticing the old dilapidated building behind the depot, its windows filled with the stray cats and dogs. The dogs appear healthy, with a few having thin coats, indicating they might not have had proper nutrition recently. Their eyes, full of warmth and longing, hold a deep sense of need and vulnerability. I feel an overwhelming urge to shelter them from the harsh world.
